Add ♩, ♪, ♫ and ♬ to symbols.dic (#21191)

Fixes #9158
Summary of the issue:

Music symbols ♩, ♪, ♫ and ♬ aren't spoken by NVDA.
Description of user facing changes:

Music symbols ♩, ♪, ♫ and ♬ are now spoken by NVDA.
Description of developer facing changes:

None.
Description of development approach:

Added ♩ as quarter note, ♪ as eighth note, ♫ as beamed eighth notes, and ♬ as beamed sixteenth notes to symbols.dic.
